name: ClearKeyId
evidence: clears the two words of a KeyId (an 8-byte memset through func_001F5C0C); callers call it before filling words 0 ^ 5 and 1 ^ 7 of a key

name: InitHeap
evidence: sets the heap start to the image end rounded to 16, the end to 0x2000000, resets the permanent, front and back cursors and the back mark index, and inits the heap lock; sits in the start-up function table D_002647C0

name: ReservePermanentMemory
evidence: takes size rounded up to 16 from the heap base D_002C2A14, advances it, and sets both the reset mark D_002C2A18 and the front pointer D_002C2A1C to the new base

name: CheckAllocationSize
evidence: takes a size and does nothing; AllocateFrontMemory and AllocateBackMemory call it before they move their cursors

name: AllocateFrontMemory
evidence: returns D_002C2A1C and advances it by size rounded up to 16 (0 for size 0)

name: ResetFrontMemory
evidence: sets the front pointer D_002C2A1C back to the mark D_002C2A18

name: CopyToFrontMemory
evidence: allocates size bytes with func_0018D500 and copies size bytes from src into them with func_0018D800

name: AllocateZeroedFrontMemory
evidence: allocates n bytes with func_0018D500 and clears them with func_001F5C0C

name: PushBackMemoryMark
evidence: increments the index D_002C2A34 and stores the current back pointer D_002C2A20 in the array D_002C2A38 (func_0018D6F0 undoes it)

name: AllocateBackMemory
evidence: lowers the back pointer D_002C2A20 by size rounded up to 16 and returns it

name: AllocateZeroedBackMemory
evidence: allocates size bytes with func_0018D658 and clears them with func_001F5C0C

name: PopBackMemoryMark
evidence: restores the back pointer D_002C2A20 from D_002C2A38[D_002C2A34] and decrements the index

name: EnterRuntimeLock
evidence: returns 0; the frame-info registry functions of the C++ runtime (func_001FD990, func_001FF518, func_001FF848) call it before touching their lists, and LeaveRuntimeLock after

name: LeaveRuntimeLock
evidence: does nothing; the frame-info registry functions (func_001FE9F8, func_001FF1E0, DeregisterFrameInfo) call it after the work they open with EnterRuntimeLock

name: AllocateObjectMemory
evidence: returns AllocateZeroedFrontMemory of its size: the allocation the libraries and CloneFont call for a new object

name: FreeObjectMemory
evidence: does nothing: the release a deleting destructor calls (some dozen callers, as func_00137290's flag-1 path), since front memory is only freed by a reset

name: CopyQuadwords
evidence: copies n 128-bit values, the remainder n & 3 first and then four per iteration

name: CopyMemory
evidence: byte copy when dst, src or size is not word aligned, word copy when not 16-byte aligned, otherwise 16-byte block copy through func_0018D780
